title: Quarante Quatre 2
preamble:
Ingredients:-
1
litre vodka
1
orange
44
cloves
44
white sugar cubes - 175g of granulated sugar
44
dark roast coffee beans
1
cinnamon stick

Method:-
Pierce the orange 44 times with a sharp fruit knife.
Stuff 44 cloves into the slashes.
Add to a large sealable, sterilised jar.
Add the other ingredients.
Shake well.
Move to cool, dark place.
Shake well daily for 44 days.
Decant to fancy bottles.
Serve well chilled (even from the freezer).
Will keep and mature for years.
